name: @ismail-elkorchi/text-computing
description: Single-entrypoint SDK for Text Computing NLP workflows.

scripts.lint: biome check src test scripts README.md package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json --files-ignore-unknown=true
scripts.test:node:run: node --test test/suite.ts test/runtime/node.test.ts test/consumer/en-consumer-smoke.ts test/consumer/fr-reussite-smoke.ts test/consumer/ar-consumer-smoke.ts
scripts.test:bun:run: if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun test test/runtime/bun.test.ts; elif [ -n "$CI" ]; then echo 'error: bun is required in CI' >&2; exit 1; else echo 'skip: bun not installed'; fi
scripts.test:node: npm run test:prepare && npm run test:node:run
scripts.test:deno: npm run test:prepare && npm run test:deno:run
scripts.test:bun: npm run test:prepare && npm run test:bun:run
scripts.test:browser: npm run test:prepare && npm run test:browser:run
scripts.test:workers: npm run test:prepare && npm run test:workers:run
scripts.test:all: npm run test:prepare && npm run test:node:run && npm run test:deno:run && npm run test:bun:run && npm run test:browser:run && npm run test:workers:run
